symptom.name: Controller not responding
symptom.description: Robot controller not responding; LED indicators not lit.

failure_modes.name: Main fuse (Q1) might have tripped
failure_modes.description: The mains fuse Q1 inside the Drive Module has tripped.

symptom.name: All LEDs are OFF at Controller
symptom.description: No LEDs at all are lit on the Control Module or the Drive Module.

failure_modes.name: Drive Module power supply failure
failure_modes.description: The Drive Module power supply receives 230 VAC but its LEDs remain off.

failure_modes.name: Circuit breaker F6 is malfunctioning or open
failure_modes.description: Circuit breaker F6 (if used) is malfunctioning or open for any other reason.

failure_modes.name: The system is not supplied with power
failure_modes.description: The system is not supplied with power.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the Drive Module power supply
corrective_actions.description: Replace the Drive Module power supply when incoming voltage is correct but its LEDs remain off.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: If the power supply incoming voltage is correct (230 VAC) but the LEDs still do not work, replace the Drive Module power supply.
corrective_actions.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

corrective_actions.name: Switch on the main switch and supply the system with power
corrective_actions.description: Switch on the main switch and restore system power.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Restore the system power supply after switching on the main switch.
corrective_actions.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

symptom.name: No voltage in service outlet
symptom.description: No voltage is available in the Control Module service outlet.

failure_modes.name: Tripped circuit breaker (F5)
failure_modes.description: The circuit breaker F5 has tripped.

failure_modes.name: Tripped earth fault protection (F4)
failure_modes.description: The earth fault protection F4 has tripped.

symptom.name: Problem jogging the robot
symptom.description: The system can be started but the joystick on the FlexPendant does not work.

failure_modes.name: The joystick is malfunctioning
failure_modes.description: The joystick on the FlexPendant is malfunctioning.

symptom.name: Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes
symptom.description: The area surrounding the motor or gearbox shows signs of oil leaks.

failure_modes.name: Leaking seal between gearbox and motor
failure_modes.description: The seal between gearbox and motor is leaking oil.

failure_modes.name: Gearbox overfilled with oil
failure_modes.description: The gearbox is overfilled with oil.

corrective_actions.name: Replace seals and gaskets as specified
corrective_actions.description: Replace leaking seals and gaskets as specified for the robot.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Inspect all seals and gaskets between motor and gearbox. Replace seals and gaskets as specified in the product manual for the robot.
corrective_actions.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

symptom.name: Mechanical noise
symptom.description: A faulty bearing emits scraping, grinding, or clicking noises shortly before failing.

corrective_actions.name: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication
corrective_actions.description: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Restore sufficient bearing lubrication as specified in the product manual for the robot.
corrective_actions.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

symptom.name: Manipulator crashes on power down
symptom.description: When Motors OFF is active the manipulator collapses under its own weight.

failure_modes.name: Faulty motor holding brake
failure_modes.description: The holding brake integral to a motor is faulty.

failure_modes.name: Faulty power supply to the brake
failure_modes.description: The power supply to the motor holding brake is faulty.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the motor as a complete unit
corrective_actions.description: Replace a faulty motor and its integral holding brake as a complete unit.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Replace the motor as a complete unit if it is found faulty.
corrective_actions.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

symptom.name: Problem releasing Robot brakes
symptom.description: The internal robot brakes do not release, no robot movement is possible.

failure_modes.name: Faulty brake on the robot axis
Brake contactor (K44) does not work correctly
failure_modes.description: The brake contactor K44 does not work correctly.

failure_modes.name: Supply voltage 24V BRAKE missing
failure_modes.description: The 24V BRAKE supply voltage is missing.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the faulty brake
corrective_actions.description: Replace the single faulty robot-axis brake.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Replace the faulty brake if just one of the brakes malfunctions.
corrective_actions.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual
